subject: dispatch_io_create

observation.summary: _dispatch_io_create is defined at arm64e offset 0x0002C640 (the read/write/path trio's underlying constructor); _dispatch_io_create_f at 0x0002C9FD and the public dispatch_io_create trio in src/io.c share the same struct anchor.

claim: dispatch_io_create is exported by libdispatch (macOS 27 / arm64e) as a defined global text symbol _dispatch_io_create at offset 0x2C640, with the public name dispatch_io_create resolving through Apple's leading-underscore rename. The associated trio dispatch_io_create / dispatch_io_create_f / dispatch_io_create_with_path / dispatch_io_create_with_path_f / dispatch_io_create_with_io (OSS src/io.c L355, L406, L421, L527) is co-resident in the same translation unit and is part of the high-level I/O channel API introduced alongside libdispatch 200-series.
